module: Drives the livery editor camera: preset views around the vehicle (top, left, right, back, front), framing the camera on a decal's angle, and a "transform" mode where the camera switches to free camera or orbit while placing a decal. Movements are run in jobs (core_jobsystem) because the camera needs a frame to update. Used by the livery UI via ui_liveries_camera.
notes: A running camera job is cancelled as soon as a new request arrives (activeRequestId is used to ignore stale jobs).
setView emits the UI event "liveries_camera_viewApplied" with { view = id } after a fixed 0.35 s delay, because the orbit has no completion callback (see core/cameraModes/orbit.lua).
Orbit rotations are vec3 in degrees (yaw, pitch, roll): top (90,-90,0), left (-90,0,0), right (90,0,0), back (0,0,0), front (180,0,0).
A decal is considered "orthographic" if its camera direction is within 0.98 dot product of one of the six axes (top, left, right, back, front); it is then framed on the matching preset view.
In transform mode, if mouse placement is active (editor_api_dynamicDecals.isUseMousePos), the camera stays in orbit; otherwise it switches to free camera.
Free camera movement is multiplied by 0.1 when ui_liveries_decal.getSmallIncrements() is true.
The code contains a TODO comment indicating that captureCameraName is probably a guard that has become useless.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one: editor_api_dynamicDecals.

setup.desc: Starts the module: stores the player vehicle's current default orbit rotation to restore it later. No effect if already started.

teardown.desc: Stops the module: ends the current transform (stopTransform), cancels the camera job, and restores the default orbit rotation stored by setup. No effect if the module is not started.

getViews.desc: Returns the list of preset views for the UI.

returns.desc: Items { id, labelKey, icon } for top, left, right, back, front.

setView.desc: Applies a preset view: switches back to the game camera in orbit mode, sets the vehicle's default rotation then resets the camera, in a job. Triggers liveries_camera_viewApplied at the end.

returns.desc: false (with a warning) if the view is unknown, otherwise true.

activateOrbitMode.desc: Switches to the game camera and enables player 0's orbit camera.

panToLayer.desc: Places the free camera at the position and orientation stored in the decal (camPosition, camDirection converted to the vehicle's world frame).

layerUid.desc: Uid of a decal-type layer with a camera pose.

returns.desc: false if the layer is not found or has no camera pose.

orbitToLayer.desc: Frames the orbit camera on a decal: preset view if the decal is orthographic, otherwise rotates the orbit to the decal's angle without touching the distance.

layerUid.desc: Uid of a decal layer with a camera pose.

returns.desc: false if the layer is unusable.

previewLayer.desc: Previews a decal: preset view if it is orthographic, otherwise restores the exact angle (free camera: decal pose; orbit active: direct rotation; other camera: switches to orbit).

layerUid.desc: Uid of a decal layer with a camera pose.

returns.desc: false if the layer is unusable.

startTransformAtLayer.desc: Starts transform mode on an existing decal: stores the current camera, then frames the decal in orbit (mouse placement) or in free camera.

layerUid.desc: Uid of the decal to edit.

returns.desc: false if a transform is already active or the layer is unusable.

startTransform.desc: Starts transform mode for a new decal: stores the current camera, then keeps the orbit (mouse placement) or switches to free camera. No effect if a transform is already active.

ensureTransformOrbitMode.desc: Forces the camera into orbit during a transform. If it was free, cancels the jobs, stops the movement and, for an existing decal, puts the orbit back on its angle.

returns.desc: false if no transform is active, otherwise true.

toggleTransformCameraMode.desc: Toggles between free camera and orbit camera during a transform.

returns.desc: false if no transform is active, otherwise true.

stopTransform.desc: Ends the transform: cancels the jobs, stops the movements and rotations, switches back to the game camera, restores the stored camera and orbit rotation, then resets the camera.

panUpDown.desc: Up/down axis input during a transform. In free camera, moves up (positive value) or down (negative value); in orbit, rotates the pitch (rotate_pitch). No effect outside a transform.

filterType.desc: Input filter type passed to core_camera.rotate_pitch.

player.desc: Player passed to core_camera.rotate_pitch (inferred from code).

moveLeftRight.desc: Left/right axis input during a transform. In free camera, moves sideways; in orbit, rotates the yaw (rotate_yaw). No effect outside a transform.

filterType.desc: Input filter type passed to core_camera.rotate_yaw.

player.desc: Player passed to core_camera.rotate_yaw (inferred from code).
